messages:
deploybot: Started CI pipeline for tag v3.2.1-rc3 to canary (env=canary-us-west, commit=7a9f3d4)

lisa: rolling canary, kicking off matrix + smoke. ETA ~12m.

carlos: lint job queued on runner-8. watching.

deploybot: build: started (job id 4821).

jen: running a quick local smoke against canary endpoints. ping me if anything 500s.

deploybot: test: unit-tests matrix started (python, node). lint: running (eslint v8.12).

carlos: lint job failed quickly: `eslint src --max-warnings 0` -> 3 errors in pkg/cli.js

lisa: putting a hold on canary rollout until lint is fixed. can we quick-fix or pin?

jen: looked at errors, two are style-only, one is import-order from new eslint rule. I can push a style patch but it touches a few PRs.

carlos: alternative: pin eslint-config to previous minor in pipeline for this RC? quick but risky.

lisa: prefer a small revert/patch to keep CI honest. patch + rerun. @jen can you send?

jen: sending PR in 5. will mention canary hold.

deploybot: test: unit-tests job reported 1 flaky failing test (tests/integration/kv_cache_test.py::test_kvc_eviction), retrying once.

qa-bot: FYI observed intermittent socket timeout in smoke stage earlier (region us-west). linking logs: https://logs.internal/ev/4821/stream

lisa: thanks @qa-bot. jen, if you push patch also add a run of flaky test to ensure it's not related.

jen: PR merged (7a9f3d4 -> 8b1e9c2). I added `# noqa` for style line and a small reorder to satisfy import rule. Triggering pipeline rerun.

deploybot: pipeline rerun queued (trigger: pr-4129). build start -> runner-3.

carlos: lint passed on rerun ✅

deploybot: unit-tests: retried job passed. smoke job still running.

deploybot: smoke: failed 1 check -> `503 Service Unavailable` from /v1/health (canary-us-west), attempt 1 of 2.

lisa: hmm. is that the same socket timeout? @infra oncall?

carlos: flipping to fallback backend for canary healthcheck to rule out backend flakiness. temporary route change.

qa-bot: smoke re-run -> passed after fallback. logs: `200 OK` for /v1/health.

lisa: good. given flaky infra dependency, I recommend we hold the canary rollout and not promote this RC until we confirm the backend fix is stable.

jen: agree. we should also note in release notes candidate that canary saw transient backend 503, no user-facing errors observed in metrics.

deploybot: Pipeline status: held by lisa (reason: transient backend 503 on smoke). commit pinned: v3.2.1-rc3 @ 8b1e9c2.

lisa: filing a follow-up infra incident and scheduling another canary run in the change window tomorrow 09:00 PT. tagging stakeholders. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

carlos: adding a short-term retry policy to smoke job for next runs so infra blips don't block everything. will open PR.

jen: I'll draft the release note snippet and add the note about the hold.

deploybot: Notifying release channel and updating pipeline tag metadata. If no objections by 08:00 PT tomorrow we'll resume canary.

lisa: no objections from me. thanks team. :thumbsup:
